head: Plop Browser lets websites fill the whole iPhone screen
dek: Plop is a browser that keeps the address bar and buttons hidden until you double-tap or tap with two fingers, so pages fill the screen. It was #49 among paid Utilities apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
details: Slide across the address to switch tabs or flick up to see them all. It costs $2.99 with in-app purchases, by Stuck in the Sand.
means: If you want more of each web page on screen, it hides everything else.
todo: Find Plop Browser in the App Store.
